UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT

and JOHN/JANE DOES 1-6,

NOTICE OF WAIVER OF ORAL ARGUMENT AS TO PLAINTIFF'S MOTION TO
DISQUALIFY MAGISTRATE JUDGE IVAN D. DAVIS
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that, under Local Civil Rule 7(E), Plaintiff Marvelle J.
Ballentine, proceeding pro se, waives oral argument on Plaintiff's Motion to Disqualify Magistrate
Judge Ivan D. Davis Under 28 U.S.C. § 455(b)(4) and § 455(a), and for Priority Determination,
submitted contemporaneously with this Notice, and requests that the Court determine the Motion
on the papers under Local Civil Rule 7(J) and Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 78(b).
Plaintiff requests that the Motion be determined upon completion of the briefing permitted
by Local Civil Rule 7(F)(1), or sooner if the Court so directs, and before any further substantive
action is taken in the referred matters.
On October 12, 2026, Plaintiff submitted through the Court's Electronic Document
Submission System a Notice of Waiver of Oral Argument as to ECF Nos. 66, 67, and 76,
requesting determination of those motions on the papers under Local Civil Rule 7(J). This Notice
1

addresses only the present Motion. It does not modify any pending request concerning oral
argument on any other motion.
Date: October 13, 2026
Respectfully submitted,
Marvelle J. Ballentine
Plaintiff, pro se
1520 Belle View Blvd, Ste. #5847
Alexandria, Virginia 22307
(407) 794-6503
jayballentine@protonmail.com
2

CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE
I hereby certify that on October 13, 2026, I submitted the foregoing Notice of Waiver of
Oral Argument as to Plaintiff's Motion to Disqualify Magistrate Judge Ivan D. Davis, together
with the accompanying Certification Pursuant to Local Civil Rule 83.1(N) and Generative
Artificial Intelligence Disclosure and Citation Certification, to the Clerk of Court for filing through
the Court's Electronic Document Submission System (EDSS).
I further certify that, upon the Clerk's docketing of the submission on the Court's Case
Management/Electronic Case Filing (CM/ECF) system, a Notice of Electronic Filing will be
transmitted to counsel of record for Defendants National Center for Missing & Exploited Children,
Katie Hall, and Meta Platforms, Inc., who are registered users of that system and will be served
through that means.
Date: October 13, 2026
Marvelle J. Ballentine
Plaintiff, pro se
3

CERTIFICATION PURSUANT TO LOCAL CIVIL RULE 83.1(N)
Pursuant to Local Civil Rule 83.1(N), I declare under penalty of perjury that no attorney has
prepared, or assisted in the preparation of, any of the following documents: (1) the Notice of
Waiver of Oral Argument as to Plaintiff's Motion to Disqualify Magistrate Judge Ivan D. Davis;
(2) the Certificate of Service accompanying the Notice; (3) the Generative Artificial Intelligence
Disclosure and Citation Certification accompanying the Notice; and (4) this Certification Pursuant
to Local Civil Rule 83.1(N). This certification applies to each and every document identified
above.
Name of Pro Se Litigant: Marvelle J. Ballentine
Signature of Pro Se Litigant
Executed on: October 13, 2026
